FUNCTION MULTIPLY_MATRICES ACCEPTS(matrix1, matrix2)
  result <- EMPTY LIST
  FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF matrix1 - 1
    row <- EMPTY LIST
    FOR j FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF matrix2[0] - 1
      sum <- 0
      FOR k FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF matrix1[0] - 1
        sum <- sum + matrix1[i][k] * matrix2[k][j]
      END FOR
      row <- row + [sum]
    END FOR
    result <- result + [row]
  END FOR
  RETURN result
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION MULTIPLY_MATRICES ACCEPTS(matrix1, matrix2)
  result <- EMPTY LIST
  FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF matrix1 - 1
    row <- EMPTY LIST
    FOR j FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF matrix2[0] - 1
